purpose: Remove external titles, subtitles, and top-margin slogans from all concept boards, including the English product artwork.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing toxee desktop-and-phone UI concept board.
Input image: the supplied board is the exact edit target.
Primary request: Remove ALL text in the top outer margin ABOVE the desktop application window and phone device. Remove the large A/B/C/D style heading, all "toxee / 界面风格提案" or "Interface style concept" subtitles, the appearance-board heading/subtitle, and any small Chinese or English marketing slogans in that outside top margin. Also erase title-related rules/underlines so no orphan title decorations remain. Fill these erased lettering areas seamlessly with the surrounding original pale background.
Invariants: keep the original image dimensions and framing. Keep the desktop and phone at their original positions. Preserve EVERY pixel of interface content INSIDE the desktop window and phone: brand wordmark, navigation labels, settings headings, names, text messages, timestamps, numbers, avatars, icons, buttons, outlines, shadows, colors, and safe areas. Do not translate, retype, add, remove or redesign ANY UI content. Retain any standalone non-text illustration outside the UI. This is solely removal of external top-of-board lettering. Do not crop, scale, move, or redraw the interfaces. No replacement title, caption, logo or watermark. The entire former top heading area must have no letters or words.
note: Root README and product-page references retain their paths and language variants. Historical generation prompts remain separately recorded in prompts.json.
verification: All eight unique boards inspected visually; OCR found no external top headings or subtitles. Dimensions retained. Chinese product image matches the modified Chinese Modern board.
limitation: Generative edits are not pixel-identical. The Night Link phone sample timestamp below 好嘞，今晚把路线发你 changed from 09:36 to 08:36. Three corrective image_gen attempts were ineffective; the first title-free output remains selected. This concerns concept art only, not application code or real messages.
